headings: ## Quick start — PROV Primer publication status
### Level 1 — Find and verify one bounded answer
### Level 2 — Compare a small evidence set
### Level 3 — Produce a focused decision-ready report
### Level 4 — Handle contested, scaled and changing evidence
### Level 5 — Run a research programme that feeds production
## Project structure grows with the research

examples.title: PROV Primer publication status
examples.evaluation: Evaluate source identity, exact status/date support, scope and truthful self-check.
examples.negative_contract: Exact official status versus conformance overclaim; FX04/FX10. Producer only, no pack; canonical keyless quick start.

examples.title: Python requirement claim audit
examples.evaluation: Evaluate claim scope, source entailment and input preservation.
examples.negative_contract: Package/deployment conflation and unchanged audit submission; FX10/AU01. Evaluator only.

examples.title: Repair-data count scope
examples.evaluation: Evaluate unit definition and release/observation/read dates.
examples.negative_contract: Count unit and observation versus retrieval date; FX03/TM02. Producer only.

examples.title: Scholarly metadata routes
examples.evaluation: Evaluate criteria, currentness, primary authority and metadata/full-text limits.
examples.negative_contract: Official API evidence versus wrapper/metadata substitution; FX04/FX07. Producer and evaluator, core only.

examples.title: RULER report versions
examples.evaluation: Evaluate work/report linkage, revised scope and threshold applicability.
examples.negative_contract: Work/report/version linkage and changed population; FX06/FX09. Producer and evaluator.

examples.title: Small numeric repair comparison
examples.evaluation: Evaluate reproducible arithmetic, complete denominators and bounded inference.
examples.negative_contract: Complete denominator including Unknown and reproducible calculation; PR01. Producer/evaluator with actual local data execution.

examples.title: Long-context research evidence
examples.evaluation: Evaluate scholarly appraisal and transfer limits separately from citation syntax.
examples.negative_contract: Scholarly unit/status and limited transfer; FX05/FX06/FX09, PD01. Explicit scholarly-evidence.

examples.title: Repair-software opportunity evidence
examples.evaluation: Evaluate decision relevance without unsupported demand claims.
examples.negative_contract: Activity does not prove demand or willingness to pay; FX09/FX11. Core only.

examples.title: Optional research-engine adoption
examples.evaluation: Evaluate pack effects, documentary versus runtime evidence and provider boundaries.
examples.negative_contract: Static observations versus actual installation readiness; AU01/FX10, PD02. Explicit open-source-ecosystem.

examples.title: API-policy reconstruction and refresh
examples.evaluation: Evaluate temporal semantics and smallest-sufficient refresh.
examples.negative_contract: Retrospective versus current policy, announcement and implementation; FX03/TM02/TM03. Producer/evaluator refresh and diagnosis.

examples.title: Longitudinal repair-data reconciliation
examples.evaluation: Evaluate calculation fidelity, snapshot dependence and repair preservation.
examples.negative_contract: Snapshot double counting, schema/denominator repair, preserved calculations; FX06/PR01/TM03. Core, bounded data acquisition.

examples.title: Multi-repository evidence audit
examples.evaluation: Evaluate multi-hop provenance, independence and targeted follow-up at source-set scale.
examples.negative_contract: Shared engines, sampled histories, bounded follow-up and locator repair; FX01/FX10/BG02, PD02. OSS pack.

examples.title: Archival-research domain programme
examples.evaluation: Evaluate research-before-architecture, catalogue-first qualification and explicit handoff ownership. The creator qualification can also be tested as a selective-install subtask using the explicitly supplied catalogue and programme request.
examples.negative_contract: Catalogue-first create-pack qualification and research-before-architecture; FX11/AU01, pack precedence suite. All three skills; creator-only qualification also tested selectively.

examples.title: Watershed system for production
examples.evaluation: Evaluate scientific context, abstraction boundaries and evidence-preserving multi-domain handoff.
examples.negative_contract: Scientific units and empirical/model/simulation distinction; FX09/PR01/TM03. Core, three domain handoffs.

examples.title: Evidence-linked briefing opportunity
examples.evaluation: Evaluate programme consistency, competing constraints, disconfirming evidence and preserved downstream judgement.
examples.negative_contract: Conditional opportunity, permitted use and scoped refresh; FX09/FX11/TM03. Core, business/software/editorial handoffs.
